artifact_types: five-dimension case quality score in the coverage matrix
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: Every test case must trace to approved behavior or risk and state preconditions, data, action, observable expected result, priority, and test level; exported volume cannot substitute for coverage quality.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
A portfolio must justify every layer by observable risk and feedback value; test-count targets, pyramid dogma, and duplicate assertions across layers are not strategy.
inputs: Approved requirements, risk profile, platform, test level, data constraints, and downstream format.
System architecture, risks, component types, environments, and data constraints.
outputs: five-dimension case quality score in the coverage matrix
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 2 related modes: Derive traceable executable test cases, risk priority, data needs, coverage gaps, and one consumer-specific export from approved requirements without implementing tests.; Design a risk-based portfolio of static, unit, integration, contract, browser, performance, accessibility, security, and manual checks with ownership and feedback goals.
